angu_builder.text: Anguilla's racing sloops are built from memory by shipwrights who learned from their fathers. Wood, nails, patience and arguments.
Racing sloops carry a sail the size of a house and a crew that leans out on planks. If it tips, it tips. If it sinks, you swim ashore.

angu_apprentice.text: I sweep the sawdust. In seven years I'll be allowed to plane a plank. In fourteen, nail one.
My boss says the boat's got a spirit. I've not met it. It keeps hiding.
